title: Feelings & Staying Safe
subject: Integrated Studies
description: All feelings are okay — let's learn to name them and stay safe!

video.title: Learn Happy, Sad, and More Emotions | Elmo's World

steps: Everyone has feelings: happy, sad, angry, scared, excited — and ALL feelings are okay.
Use your words to say how you feel: 'I feel sad because...' That helps others help you!
If a feeling is too big, take slow deep breaths — smell the flower, blow out the candle. 🌸🕯️
Stay safe: if anything makes you feel scared or uncomfortable, tell a grown-up you trust — like a parent or teacher.

questions.prompt: Is it okay to feel sad or angry sometimes?
questions.hint: Everyone has all kinds of feelings.

questions.prompt: What can you do when a feeling gets too big?
questions.hint: Smell the flower, blow out the candle.

questions.prompt: If something makes you feel scared or uncomfortable, what should you do?
questions.hint: Like a parent or your teacher.

questions.prompt: Which words tell someone how you feel?
questions.correct: I feel sad because I lost my toy
questions.hint: Naming the feeling helps others help you!
